ترتكبوا (form VIII)
# تَرْتَكِبُوا (tartakibū) /tar.ta.ki.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
# تُرْتَكَبُوا (turtakabū) /tur.ta.ka.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
